blocks.text: WASHINGTON — Voters delivered a significant rebuke to President Donald Trump by handing Democrats control of the Senate on Tuesday, rejecting his handpicked candidates that he had furiously barnstormed for in the final weeks of the midterm campaign. Democratic candidates flipped Republican-held seats in North Carolina, Ohio, Iowa, Texas, South Carolina and Kansas, where the president had personally chosen the GOP nominees or tried to rally voters on their behalf with campaign stops. The results were also a major reprimand from voters of Trump, who repeatedly urged voters to “pretend I’m on the ballot” as he went into primarily conservative states […]...
